name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
desc: Low-code platform for building and publishing enterprise agents
desc_zh: 低代码平台，用于构建并发布企业级智能体
solves: Every department wants its own bot, and hand-coding each one does not scale. You describe the agent and connect it to the data it needs.
solves_zh: 每个部门都想要自己的机器人，手写代码显然撑不起规模。你把智能体描述出来，再接上它需要的数据。
best_for: When people outside engineering need to publish an internal bot without writing code.
best_for_zh: 当工程之外的人也要不写代码就发布一个内部机器人时。
